moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base
moonshine-base.description: Very fast, English only. Handles accents well.

moonshine-small-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Small

capabilities.streaming: Shows live transcription as you speak

localPolishing.title: Local polishing
localPolishing.label: Polish voice input locally
localPolishing.description: Conservatively clean up speech using Qwen3-0.6B on this Mac. Enabled personalization supplies terminology context only. Without it, use basic cleanup. Preserve meaning and spoken languages. Inputs over 200 characters skip polishing. Keep the original if the model is unavailable, output is invalid or processing exceeds 500 ms. Turning this off releases the loaded model.
localPolishing.error: Local polishing is unavailable. Your original transcript will be kept. Delete and download the model again, or turn polishing off and on.

language.description: Select the language for speech recognition. Auto will automatically determine the language, while selecting a specific language can improve accuracy for that language.

shortcutActivation.description: Choose how the transcribe shortcut starts and stops recording.

general.pageDescription: Configure shortcuts, recognition language, and recording preferences.

models.title: Transcription Models
models.description: Select a transcription model or download additional models. Different models offer varying levels of accuracy and speed.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?

filters.streaming: Filter models that support live streaming transcription
filters.translation: Filter models that support translation to English

rescan.label: Rescan
rescan.tooltip: Rescan for models added to the models folder or Hugging Face cache outside Yanyu

channel.title: Input Channel
channel.description: Select which input channel to record from. Use this if your audio interface has multiple inputs.

audioFeedback.label: Audio Feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops
audioFeedback.disabledHint: Enable audio feedback to adjust playback device and volume.

outputDevice.title: Output Device
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental Features
experimentalToggle.description: Enable experimental features that are still in development.

lazyStreamClose.label: Keep Mic Open Between Transcriptions
lazyStreamClose.description: Keeps the microphone stream open for 30 seconds after recording stops, reducing latency for back-to-back transcriptions. May degrade Bluetooth audio quality while active.

transcribe.title: transcribe.cpp Acceleration
transcribe.description: Hardware acceleration for transcribe.cpp (Whisper-family) models. Auto uses GPU if available (Metal on macOS, Vulkan on Windows/Linux).

ort.title: ONNX Acceleration
ort.description: Hardware acceleration for ONNX models (Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine, etc.). DirectML on Windows is experimental. Models may fail to transcribe.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start Yanyu when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show Tray Icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the Yanyu icon in the system tray.

style.title: Overlay
style.description: Choose the recording overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill, Live shows transcription in real time as you speak (streaming-capable models only — look for the Streaming badge in the model picker). On Linux 'None' is recommended.

position.title: Overlay Position
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen during recording and transcription.

pasteMethod.title: Paste Method
pasteMethod.description: Choose how text is inserted. Direct: simulates typing via system input. None: skips paste, only updates history/clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing Tool
typingTool.description: Choose which Linux typing tool to use for Direct paste method. Auto will automatically detect and use the best available tool for your system.

clipboardHandling.title: Clipboard Handling
clipboardHandling.description: Don't Modify Clipboard preserves your current clipboard contents after transcription. Copy to Clipboard leaves the transcription result in your clipboard after pasting.

autoSubmit.title: Auto Submit
autoSubmit.description: Automatically send the selected key combination after text insertion. Cmd+Enter applies on macOS, while Windows/Linux use Super+Enter.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.

modelUnload.title: Unload Model
modelUnload.description: Automatically free GPU/CPU memory when the model hasn't been used for the specified time

customWords.title: Custom Words
customWords.description: Help supported models recognize names and specialized terms. Fuzzy correction is currently limited to words using A–Z and numbers.
customWords.tooLong: Words must be 50 characters or fewer.
customWords.updateFailed: Failed to update custom words. Please try again.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Voice Activity Detection
voiceActivityDetection.description: Filter silence from recordings. Streaming-capable models use a longer VAD tail; disabling VAD records raw audio.

vadBackend.title: Voice Activity Backend
vadBackend.description: Choose the detector used to filter silence. Earshot is experimental; switch back to Silero if speech is clipped or noise is retained.

fillerWordRemoval.title: Remove Filler Words
fillerWordRemoval.description: Removes common hesitation words from transcriptions. Turn off to keep them.

chineseScript.title: Chinese Script
chineseScript.description: Writes Mandarin and Cantonese transcriptions in Simplified or Traditional characters. Other languages are left unchanged.

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL for the selected provider. Only the custom provider can be edited.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionCustom: Provide the model identifier expected by your custom endpoint.
model.descriptionDefault: Choose a model exposed by the selected provider.

prompts.title: Prompt

selectedPrompt.title: Selected Prompt
selectedPrompt.description: Select a template for refining transcriptions or create a new one. Use ${output} inside the prompt text to reference the captured transcript.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Write the instructions to run after transcription. Example: Improve grammar and clarity for the following text: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tip: Use ${output} to insert the transcribed text in your prompt.
prompts.selectToEdit: Select a prompt above to view and edit its details.
prompts.createFirst: Click 'Create New Prompt' above to create your first post-processing prompt.

history.empty: No transcriptions yet. Start recording to build your history!

skipReasons.too_long: The text is longer than 200 characters.
skipReasons.unavailable: The polishing model was not ready or was busy.
skipReasons.incomplete: The model did not give a complete answer.
skipReasons.bad_format: The model output had an invalid format.
skipReasons.language_changed: The model changed the language or dropped words.
skipReasons.identifier_changed: The model changed a name, number or code term.

logDirectory.title: Log Directory
logDirectory.description: Location where log files are stored

liveLogs.title: Live Logs
liveLogs.description: Stream application logs in real time to diagnose issues without opening the log file. Only logs emitted while this panel is open are shown; respects the Log Level setting above.
liveLogs.empty: Waiting for logs… Entries appear here as the app emits them.

updateChecks.label: Check for Updates
updateChecks.description: Automatically check for new versions of Yanyu
updateChecks.lockedDescription: Updates are disabled until Yanyu releases and signing keys are configured.

whatsNewPreview.title: Preview What's New
whatsNewPreview.description: Open the latest bundled release note without marking it as seen

onboardingPreview.title: Preview Onboarding
onboardingPreview.description: Preview onboarding screens without changing permissions, models, or completion state

soundTheme.label: Sound Theme
soundTheme.description: Choose a sound theme for recording start and stop feedback

historyLimit.title: History Limit
historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep

recordingRetention.title: Auto-Delete Recordings
recordingRetention.description: Automatically delete old recordings to save space

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Always-On Microphone
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Keep microphone active for faster response

clamshellMicrophone.title: Clamshell Microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Microphone to use when laptop lid is closed

postProcessingToggle.label: Post Processing
postProcessingToggle.description: Enable AI-powered text refinement after transcription

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append Trailing Space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

keyboardImplementation.title: Keyboard Implementation
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and reset to defaults

pasteDelay.title: Paste Delay (Before)
pasteDelay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after copying text, before sending the paste keystroke. Increase if nothing gets pasted.

pasteDelayAfter.title: Paste Delay (After)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after the paste keystroke, before restoring your previous clipboard. Increase if your old clipboard content is being pasted instead of the transcription.

holdThreshold.title: Hold Threshold
holdThreshold.description: Auto mode only: how long (in milliseconds) the shortcut must be held before it counts as a hold instead of a tap. Lower if short holds keep leaving recording on; raise if deliberate taps get treated as holds.

reliablePaste.title: Reliable Paste (Beta)
reliablePaste.description: Restore the clipboard only after the target app actually reads the transcription, instead of after a fixed delay. Intended to fix old clipboard content being pasted under system load. Requires a clipboard paste method; macOS and Windows only.

recordingBuffer.title: Extra Recording Buffer
recordingBuffer.description: Extra time (in milliseconds) to keep recording after you release the key, to capture trailing audio. 0 = no extra buffer.

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Keyboard Diagnostic
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Checks whether keyboard events reach Yanyu. Only event counts are recorded — never which keys you press.
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Listening… press your shortcut a few times (e.g. Option+Space)
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input is blocking key events — keyed shortcuts cannot work until it is resolved.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: Modifier events arrived but no key events — something is suppressing keys even though Secure Input reports disabled. Please report this on GitHub.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Key events are reaching Yanyu normally.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: No events captured — did you press any keys during the test?

personalization.title: Personalization
personalization.intro: After setup, enabled personalization automatically removes fillers and unintended repetitions from each dictation while preserving meaning and spoken languages. Optional answers supply usage and terminology background.
personalization.useQuestion: What do you mainly use Yanyu for?
personalization.domainQuestion: Which field do you mainly work or study in?
personalization.disclosure: Your profile is saved on this device. With local polishing off, daily dictation and optional previews send your transcript and enabled profile context to your configured service. Disabling or deleting excludes profile context from future requests.
personalization.modeDisclosure: Automatic processing uses fixed conservative rules and optional terminology context. Saved custom prompts remain on disk and do not affect this cleanup. Cleanup aims to preserve meaning, languages, emphasis, negations and instructions. Uncertain repetitions stay.
personalization.configuredOnly: Automatic processing starts after setup. The optional preview lets you compare one sample. A configured service has not necessarily been tested.
personalization.needsAsr: Choose and download a speech recognition model before dictation or preview.
personalization.trialInfo: Optional one-minute preview: recording and stopping sends recognized text to your configured service using the same processing as daily dictation. Preview only, with no paste, messages, history or saved audio. This sample does not prove a general accuracy gain.
personalization.trialSucceeded: Service returned a result for this sample. Check that meaning and languages were preserved.
personalization.trialFallback: Processing was skipped, unavailable, timed out or returned no usable result. Original recognition is preserved.
personalization.error: Could not complete this operation. Your previous settings remain available. Try again or finish setup.
personalization.serviceGuidance: Configure a service for automatic personalization during daily dictation when local polishing is off. Local polishing uses Qwen3-0.6B on this Mac and requires no external service. Saving configuration is not a successful service test.
personalization.advancedGuidance: Custom prompts are an explicit alternative to generated cleanup. Returning to custom mode restores legacy shortcut behavior and excludes profile context. The selected custom prompt may change languages or meaning.

uses.ai_conversation: Conversations with AI (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT)

personalization.localDisclosure: Your profile and transcript stay on this Mac during local polishing and local trials. Enabled profile context supplies terminology background only. Disabling or deleting excludes profile context from future requests.
personalization.localPending: Saved; enable local polishing and finish model setup
personalization.localTrialInfo: Optional one-minute trial. Recording and stopping processes recognized text on this Mac using the same local polishing as daily dictation. No external service fallback. Preview only, with no paste, messages, history or saved audio. This sample does not prove a general accuracy gain.
personalization.localTrialSucceeded: Local polishing returned a usable result for this sample. Check that meaning and languages were preserved.

meetings.title: Meeting NoteTaker
meetings.privacy: Record and process meetings entirely on this Mac. Recordings and text stay local until you delete them. No automatic model downloads.
meetings.unsupported: Meeting recording requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 13 or later.
meetings.modelGuidance: Install MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize in Models and the Qwen3-0.6B artifacts in General → Local polishing. Downloads require your explicit action. Dictation model selection and polishing can stay unchanged.
meetings.permissions: Allow Microphone and Screen & System Audio Recording in System Settings → Privacy & Security. Online meetings require both audio sources. Screen frames are never recorded.
meetings.recovered: Recording was interrupted. Audio committed to disk is retained. Review playback and retry local processing; missing audio cannot be recovered.
meetings.stale: Transcript changed. Notes may be out of date; save, then regenerate notes.
meetings.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this meeting, its transcript, notes, and all recording files?

errors.microphone_permission_denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone, then start again.
errors.system_audio_permission_denied: Computer audio access was denied. Allow Screen & System Audio Recording in System Settings → Privacy & Security, restart the app if requested, then start again.
errors.system_audio_unavailable: Computer audio is unavailable. Check a display is connected and permissions are granted, then start again.
errors.missing_moss_model: Install MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize explicitly from Models, then retry.
errors.missing_qwen_model: Download Qwen3-0.6B explicitly in General → Local polishing, then retry. Enabling dictation polishing is optional.
errors.capture_disk_error: Recording stopped because a file could not be written. Free disk space and retry processing the audio already committed.
errors.capture_interrupted: Recording was interrupted. Review recovered audio and retry processing.
errors.system_audio_interrupted: Computer audio was interrupted. The meeting capture is incomplete; review retained audio before retrying processing.
errors.processing_interrupted: Local processing was interrupted. The recording and completed transcript windows are retained. Retry to continue.
errors.processing_cancelled: Local processing was cancelled. Completed transcript windows and existing notes are retained. Retry when ready.
errors.playback_failed: Playback failed. Check that the retained recording is available and try again.
errors.processing_failed: The operation failed. Your retained recording and completed text are preserved. Check permissions, installed models, and free disk space, then retry. Technical details describe the failure.

meetings.qualityWarning: Speaker identity and note accuracy are experimental. Review the full transcript: the small note model can miss tasks or misclassify proposals.
meetings.notesDraft: Generated meeting notes are a draft. Verify each source citation: tasks can be missed and proposals can be misclassified.
meetings.captureIncomplete: This recording is incomplete. Later transcription or notes cannot restore missing audio. Review playback before retrying processing.
meetings.durabilityWarning: The edit was saved, but crash durability could not be confirmed. Keep a copy of important changes.

translation.title: Selection translation
translation.modelDescription: Qwen3-0.6B is shared by selection translation and optional Local polishing. Download it explicitly to use either feature.

errors.permission_denied: Allow Yanyu in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility, then select text and try again.
errors.unsupported_selection: This app does not expose selected text through Accessibility. Select text in another app and try again.
errors.no_selection: No selected text was found. Select text in another app and try again.
errors.too_long: Select up to 10,000 characters and try again.
errors.missing_model: Download Qwen3-0.6B in General settings to translate locally. The download starts only when you choose Download.
errors.unsupported: Selection translation requires an Apple Silicon Mac.
errors.load_failed: The local model could not load. Check the model download in General settings and try again.
errors.inference_failed: Local translation failed. Try a shorter selection.
errors.incomplete: The model did not finish a translation. Try a shorter selection.
errors.timeout: Local translation timed out. Try a shorter selection.
errors.cancelled: Translation was cancelled. Select text and try again.
errors.unavailable: Translation is unavailable. Select text in another app and try again.
errors.copy_failed: Could not copy the translation. Try again.

iosApp.tagline: Private speech input, processed on this device.
iosApp.onboardingTitle: Your voice stays on your iPhone
iosApp.onboardingBody: Yanyu records only when you ask. Speech is transcribed on this iPhone. Temporary audio is deleted after the transcript is saved; if something fails, it stays here so you can retry or delete it.
iosApp.modelMissing: A validated speech model is not installed yet.
iosApp.evaluationModelCatalog: Catalog model candidates for evaluation only
iosApp.loadingModel: Loading model into the speech engine…
iosApp.invalidModel: This file does not contain supported GGUF model metadata.
iosApp.modelPackageDamaged: The saved model package is missing or damaged. Import the model again.
iosApp.evaluateAudioHint: Use consented WAV fixtures. Enter the expected transcript to measure CER. Reports include expected and recognized text.
iosApp.evaluationFailed: Could not evaluate this WAV. Check that it is supported and a model is loaded.
iosApp.transcriptionTruncated: Transcription stopped before finishing. Review the partial text, then save it or retry the retained audio.
iosApp.transcriptionRepeated: Transcription stopped after repeated output was detected. Review the partial text, then save it or retry the retained audio.
iosApp.emptyTranscription: No text was recognized. Your recording is kept so you can retry or delete it.
iosApp.audioTooLong: This recording exceeds the current model's duration limit. Delete it and record a shorter clip.
iosApp.transcriptPlaceholder: Your transcript will appear here. You can edit it before sharing.
iosApp.historyEmpty: Your saved transcripts will appear here.
iosApp.historyUnavailableBody: Yanyu couldn't create its private on-device history store.
iosApp.permissionDenied: Microphone access is off. Allow it in Settings to record.
iosApp.audioInterrupted: Recording stopped because audio was interrupted. The captured audio is kept so you can retry or delete it.
iosApp.audioRouteChanged: Recording stopped because the audio route changed. The captured audio is kept so you can retry or delete it.
iosApp.recordingStoppedBackground: Recording stopped when Yanyu moved to the background. The captured audio is kept so you can retry or delete it.
iosApp.backgroundTranscriptionStopped: Transcription paused when Yanyu moved to the background. The captured audio is kept so you can retry or delete it.
iosApp.recoveredRecording: A recording from your last session was recovered on this iPhone. You can retry transcription or delete it.
iosApp.recordingMayBeIncomplete: The recording may be incomplete. You can still retry transcription or delete it.
iosApp.recordingInsufficientStorage: A write ran out of iPhone storage, so the recording may be incomplete. Yanyu will try to transcribe the captured audio; if that fails, you can retry or delete it.
iosApp.audioCleanupFailed: Yanyu couldn't remove the temporary recording. Delete it before starting another recording.
iosApp.privacyOnDeviceBody: Audio and transcripts are processed on this iPhone. Yanyu does not upload them.
iosApp.privacyAudioBody: Temporary audio is removed after a transcript is saved. If transcription or saving fails, it stays here so you can retry or delete it.
iosApp.privacyHistoryBody: History is stored in this app and is not synced through CloudKit. Yanyu marks the history store as excluded from device backups.
iosApp.noHistoryToDelete: No saved transcript history to delete.
iosApp.finishBeforeDeleteHistory: Finish recording or saving before deleting history.
iosApp.deleteAllHistoryHint: Permanently remove every saved transcript from this iPhone.
iosApp.deleteHistoryFailedBody: Yanyu could not save this change. Your transcript history is still available.
